experiments.title: Tyre-paper friction on six papers
experiments.purpose: Replace the assumed traction range (0.6-1.2) with measurements; pick the tyre compound
experiments.method: Horizontal-plane and rolling tribometer (TAPPI T 549 adapted) with a 2 mm wheel locked and rolling; NBR 70, PU 80 and silicone 50 Shore A tyres; copy 80 g/m2, recycled, school ruled, coated, tracing and card; 0.3 and 0.6 N; 40 and 60 % RH; 5 repeats
experiments.measurand: static and kinetic friction coefficient, rolling resistance coefficient
experiments.pass_line: kinetic mu >= 0.6 on all six papers at 0.3-0.6 N; spread (max/min) reported
experiments.needs: tribometer or tilting table, 0.01 N load cell, climate box

experiments.title: Tyre lateral stiffness and relaxation length
experiments.purpose: Check k_lat = 1.5 N/mm used by the model and the slip threshold
experiments.method: Wheel on paper at 0.55 N, lateral displacement stage 0-1 mm, force sensor under the paper
experiments.measurand: lateral force vs deflection; relaxation length when rolling

experiments.title: Holding the sheet
experiments.purpose: Know when the drive drags the paper instead of the pen
experiments.method: Heel drive pulls 0.1-0.6 N on a sheet on wood, laminate and a pad, with and without the writing hand resting and with the other hand holding
experiments.measurand: force at which the sheet slides
experiments.pass_line: >= 0.6 N with the writing hand resting
experiments.needs: spring scale or load cell; 3 desks

experiments.title: Heel geometry, roll and steering bench
experiments.purpose: Contact over tilt and roll; steering speed and bandwidth
experiments.method: 3-D printed heel with the sprung wheel pod; pen held in a tilt-roll fixture at 35-75 deg and +/-25 deg roll; steering step and chirp responses with the Hall angle sensor
experiments.measurand: contact yes/no, wheel load; steering bandwidth (-3 dB), rate limit
experiments.pass_line: contact at +/-20 deg roll over 35-75 deg; >= 40 Hz; >= 300 rad/s

experiments.title: Slip detection
experiments.method: Drive the wheel on six papers; impose slips by lowering the preload or raising the command; record optical flow and wheel odometry at 1 kHz
experiments.measurand: detection latency; false flags per 10 s of normal writing motion
experiments.pass_line: detect within 50 ms; < 1 false flag per 10 s
experiments.needs: paper sensor board, encoder, high-speed camera

experiments.title: Noise, heat and power
experiments.purpose: Check the power budget and comfort
experiments.method: Run recorded drive commands from the SIM tasks on the bench drive; microphone at 30 cm in a quiet room; thermocouples on windings and sleeve; supply current logging
experiments.measurand: dB(A); winding and surface temperature; mean electrical power

experiments.title: Force cap, stall and lift safety
experiments.purpose: Show the drive never exceeds its caps and lets go
experiments.method: Handle clamped to a 3-axis load cell over paper; commanded forces up to saturation; stall the wheel; lift the pen mid-push; fault injection (sensor loss, motor short)
experiments.measurand: peak and steady force; time to zero after lift or stall
experiments.pass_line: steady <= 0.5 N; peak <= 0.6 N; zero within 20 ms of lift

experiments.title: Guided writing with people (tracing, loops, reversed letters, resist)
experiments.purpose: Compare heel drive, desk board and nose alone on real hands
experiments.method: n = 12 adults then children with dysgraphia (ethics approval); crossover of none / nose / board / heel steer-only / heel steer + drive; tracing, 'write big' loops, b-d reversal; a 'resist' block; unassisted retention block after 1 day
experiments.measurand: target error, letters read by the app, felt force (instrumented handle), yields, preference, retention
experiments.pass_line: heel >= board on target error with felt force p95 <= 0.5 N; every participant can overpower it; no retention loss vs none

experiments.title: Tremor: constraint and damping
experiments.purpose: Test steer + brake and the ball damper on tremor and on clean writing
experiments.method: People with ET (n >= 8): copy and free writing with none / nose / heel steer + brake / heel + nose; controls without tremor for false correction
experiments.measurand: ink error, words read, distortion of clean writing
experiments.pass_line: tremor ink error -20 % with clean-writing distortion <= 100 um

experiments.title: Ink smear and wheel track
experiments.purpose: Make sure the wheel does not smear ink or mark the paper
experiments.method: Wheel rolled over fresh gel and ballpoint ink at 0.55 N; 1 page of writing; magnified images
experiments.pass_line: no ink pick-up; no visible track at 30 cm

experiments.title: Lead-through and autowrite with relaxed hands
experiments.purpose: Check that the drive can lead a relaxed hand and that people accept it
experiments.method: n = 8; relaxed-hand instruction; lead speeds 4-10 mm/s; practice sentence; comfort questionnaire
experiments.measurand: letters read, pen speed, force, comfort
experiments.pass_line: >= 70 % letters read at >= 5 mm/s with no discomfort

experiments.title: Durability
experiments.method: Wheel rolled 10 km on copy paper at 0.55 N (about 5000 pages, ASSUMPTION), friction re-measured every 1 km
experiments.pass_line: mu within 20 % of new; diameter loss < 0.05 mm

experiments.title: Driven-ball fallback: roller drag and wear
experiments.purpose: Decide whether the driven ball (better tracing and tremor numbers in SIM) can be built with low internal drag
experiments.method: Bench ball drive: 2 mm urethane-coated ball, two rollers r 0.4 mm, smooth vs micro omni-type rollers (if they can be made); push the ball along each roller axis and across; 1 km rolling on paper
experiments.measurand: internal drag across the driven axis, drive force, wear, dust pick-up
experiments.pass_line: drag <= 50 mN across the driven axis after 1 km (the SIM assumed 30 mN; smooth rollers: about 0.22 N, CALC)

decision_text: Heel drive for Rev J (proposed): a 2 mm steered wheel with an O-ring tyre at the bottom of a larger skid ring (contact radius 8.75 mm instead of 6.75 mm), steered about the paper normal through its contact point. Steer-only by default (passive guidance and tremor constraint); its drive motor is used only in an explicit lead-through or autowrite mode. Force cap 0.5 N and 0.8 x mu_hat x wheel load; yields to the writer. The driven ball is the fallback; omni-wheels, braked ball and controllable friction pads are rejected. The front sleeve grows from 15.0 to 18.3 mm at the heel and the paper sensor becomes mandatory. Adopt only after EXP-D01, EXP-D05, EXP-D07 and EXP-D08.
